entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis in Theros's Nessian Forest populated mainly by women and children, favored by the god Karametra.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane containing the poleis Meletis, Akros, Skophos and Setessa.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The god patron of Setessa who nominally serves as its queen and is the god of orphans.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The god whose domain is the Nessian Wood and who is honored at Setessa's four nexuses.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god of the Underworld to whom offerings are made at the Winter Nexus.

entities.name: Thamuzus
entities.description: Karametra's beloved human priest, who died at the Miraculous Field.

entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: Leader of Leina Tower and head of Setessa's Ruling Council.

entities.name: Phaedra
entities.description: A nineteen-year-old former orphan from Meletis who leads Hyrax Tower.

entities.name: Niketa
entities.description: Leader of Bassara Tower, a woman in her fifties who supervises archery training.

entities.name: Kallias
entities.description: Leader of Ophis Tower, who was sold into slavery as a child before being rescued by the Ophis.

entities.name: Silverbrow
entities.description: The centaur oracle, fifth member of Setessa's Ruling Council.

entities.name: Anikthea
entities.description: A former Setessan Ruling Council member dragged to the Underworld by Erebos who serves Setessa as a demigod.

entities.name: Renata
entities.description: A legendary hunter later chosen by Nylea as her demigod and champion.

entities.name: Nikaia
entities.description: A Setessan archer who became the first caryatid.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker and later God of revels, originally born in Setessa.

entities.name: Ruling Council
entities.description: Setessa's five-member council formed by popular vote that governs while Karametra is absent.

entities.name: Temple to Karametra
entities.description: A limestone shrine at the center of Setessa, ringed by three ancient trees.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: The sprawling forest revered as Nylea's domain, partly patrolled by Setessa's Bassara regiment.

entities.name: Amatrophon
entities.description: A menagerie on Setessa's northwestern edge where animals and the few resident men train.

entities.name: Miraculous Field
entities.description: A farm outside Setessa producing healing fruits and grains, said to be Karametra's tribute to Thamuzus.

entities.name: Arkulli
entities.description: The children of Setessa, mostly orphans, whose training is part of every warrior's occupation.

events.summary: Karametra teaches people to live in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa.
events.quote: the god Karametra tried to teach people a new way of living in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa

events.summary: Karametra's priest Thamuzus dies at the Miraculous Field, to which Karametra pays tribute.
events.quote: The field is said to be Karametra's tribute to her beloved human priest, Thamuzus , who died there.

events.summary: Erebos drags Anikthea, a former council member, to the Underworld, where she becomes a demigod serving Setessa.
events.quote: Dragged to the Underworld by Erebos , she serves Setessa's interests as a demigod

events.summary: Nylea chooses the legendary hunter Renata as her demigod and champion.
events.quote: legendary hunter later chosen by Nylea as her demigod and champion

events.summary: The Setessan archer Nikaia becomes the first caryatid.
events.quote: a Setessan archer who became the first caryatid

relations.quote: Setessa is the favored polis of Karametra , who nominally serves as its queen.
